source.title: Trends and open problems in the theory of random dynamical systems

trace.notes: Normalized the input as a zbMATH bibliographic resolver URL with trailing identifier 1188956.

Local workflow metadata for the same zbMATH source records the title, year 1998, and source type open problems. The exact title was used only for source identity and recovery searches, not for question extraction.

Failure modes classified as paywalled_or_restricted, metadata_only, and network_or_dns_failure. Resolved the title to Ludwig Arnold's chapter in Probability Towards 2000, pages 34-46, with DOI 10.1007/978-1-4612-2224-8_2. The Springer chapter page exposed only an abstract, references, and subscription-preview text, not the full technical chapter body; the book page likewise indicated subscription access. The local shell cannot fetch external URLs because CODEX_SANDBOX_NETWORK_DISABLED=1 caused DNS failures for api.zbmath.org.

Ran exact-work recovery attempts using the zbMATH identifier, the exact title plus PDF, the exact title plus author, and DOI 10.1007/978-1-4612-2224-8_2. Inspected exact or near-exact candidates including Springer, ResearchGate, WorldCat, Google Books, Hugendubel, Lehmanns, and citation pages in later articles. The candidates were rejected because they were subscription previews, abstracts, table-of-contents or catalog records, citation metadata, search snippets, or related works rather than a readable full-text artifact for the same chapter.

No candidates were mapped, extracted, rewritten, deduplicated, or accepted because no readable full-text PDF or HTML source could be confirmed and accessed for the same exact zbMATH source. The workflow forbids extracting questions from resolver metadata, abstracts, table-of-contents pages, catalog pages, citation lists, search snippets, or related works.
Saved final JSON to outputs/parse-paper/1188956.json and outputs/latest.json.
